password_setting.label: API Token
password_setting.help: A Cato Networks service API key. In the Cato platform, go to Resources > Service API Keys, create a key for a Service Principal with the API Permission set to Downgrade to View, and copy the token.

additional_config_fields.label: Cato Account ID
additional_config_fields.help: Your Cato Networks account ID. In the Cato platform, go to Account > Account Info and copy the Account ID.

additional_config_fields.label: Region
additional_config_fields.help: The region prefix from your Cato management URL. For example, enter us1 if your URL is cc.us1.catonetworks.com. Leave empty if your URL is cc.catonetworks.com.
